title: Ryanair CEO warns fares could rise by up to 20% next year
summary: Ryanair's CEO, Michael O'Leary, has issued a warning regarding a potential increase in airfares for European airlines, predicting a rise of up to 20% in the coming year. This forecast is largely attributed to escalating fuel costs, which have been a significant concern for the aviation industry. O'Leary's comments highlight the financial pressures that airlines face and the impact these may have on consumers. As travel demand continues to recover, the implications of higher fares could affect many travelers across Europe.
